'''Ord Adinorr''' was a snow-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]].

== Description ==
Ord Adinorr is a world covered in snow and ice. Snow falls on a daily basis, evaporating in the noonday sun only to condense and fall again overnight. The world is populated by human settlers who build their homes deep in the thick snow banks that blanket the planet, reinforcing them with plasteel. Most such homes are accessible only by tunnels connecting covered central courtyards. 

==History==
Its [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Zerex]], eventually became [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the sector. He also maintained an expansive estate on the world with a mansion that peaked 20 feet above the snowline.
